scope: Dataset identity and full-stage membership for the published comparison. Counts are per model/reasoning condition.
verification: Every published condition uses the same case IDs per workload. Full-stage execution membership was checked against frozen selection records.
reproduction_boundary: This metadata identifies exact public benchmark inputs where access permits. It does not include benchmark problems, labels, prompts, PDFs/images, model outputs, or the original inference/grading harness. Synthetic IDs identify the tested records but cannot recreate their content without the generator; the package reproduces aggregate reporting only.

seeds.note: These seeds control different operations. No model sampling seed was supplied. Workloads using complete splits or deterministic generation do not have a subset sampling seed.
